subject.title: LongCat automatic cookie import ignores Firefox sessions

question: Should LongCat Automatic mode deliberately broaden its Chrome-only cookie-import policy to probe Firefox after Chrome?
rationale: The shared importer can support Firefox, but repository guidance prefers Chrome-only imports by default; only maintainers can decide whether LongCat's user benefit warrants this provider-specific exception.

options.title: Approve a narrow LongCat exception
options.body: Merge the Chrome-first Firefox fallback and focused browser-order test while keeping unrelated browsers out of Automatic mode.

options.title: Keep Chrome-only Automatic mode
options.body: Retain the existing policy and require Firefox users to choose an explicit cookie-source configuration or provide a Cookie header.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow LongCat exception
recommendation.body: Merge the Chrome-first Firefox fallback and focused browser-order test while keeping unrelated browsers out of Automatic mode.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, steipete is the best available decision owner for a provider-cookie import policy exception.
